Method of Attack: Distributed via fake ISP complaint emails containing a zip attachment with a JS file that downloads and executes Locky ransomware
Installation via encrypted DLL executed by Rundll32.exe
Encrypts files by scrambling names and appending .aesir extension
Attempts to remove Shadow Volume Copies to prevent recovery
Attack Vector: Email phishing with fake ISP complaint emails
Execution of JS attachment leading to DLL download and execution
Indicators of Compromise: Emails with subject 'Spam mailout' containing zip attachments named logs_[target_name].zip
Encrypted files with .aesir extension and scrambled filenames
DLL file executed via Rundll32.exe with command similar to 'C:\Windows\System32\rundll32.exe %Temp%\vv3y5iUI.dll,jWo7sg8u'
